A [[human]]<ref name="Who Are You?" /> [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Who Are You? AD" /> '''radioman''' served the [[Galactic Empire]] and was present at [[Palmo Plaza]] on the [[planet]] [[Ghorman]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. In [[2 BBY]], they stayed close to [[Captain]] [[Kaido]] of the [[Imperial Army]] as he and others prepared for a [[Ghorman Massacre|massacre]] on the planet.<ref name="Who Are You?" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The radioman appeared in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series' eighth episode, "[[Who Are You?]]," which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Who Are You?" /> on [[May 6]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer News">{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}}</ref> The radioman was portrayed [[Levi Bent]] and listed in the series' credits as simply "Mobile Radioman."<ref name="Who Are You?" />
